question: Which team lost to Hyderabad FC in the finals of ISL 2021-22?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala Blasters FC**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Super League (ISL) is an Indian professional football league sponsored by Hero MotoCorp** which was founded in 2013 and competed by association football teams. 
 
• It is organized by the All Indian Football Federation (AIFF) and has 11 teams currently.
 
• Hyderabad Football Club (FC) is an Indian Football club from Hyderabad founded in 2019 in the Indian Super League. 
 
• The latest or eighth edition of ISL was held in 2021-22 behind closed doors.
 
 
• **​Hyderabad FC emerged as the champions after defeating Kerala Blasters FC. Hence option 2 is correct.**
 
• **The Jamshedpur team won the League winner's Shield.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kerala Blasters FC is a professional football club based in Kerala established in 2014. 
 
• **They are the three times runners in the ISL in 2014, and 2016 (both times defeated against ATK Mohun Bagan FC) and in 2022.**
 
• ATK Mohun Bagan FC is a professional football club based in Kolkata, West Bengal and started playing in 2020.
 
 
• ​**Earlier it was called ATK FC or ****Atlético de Kolkata formed in 2014 and won its first ISL championship.**
 
 
 
• **Goa FC** is a professional Football club from Goa that was established in 2014.
 
 
• **They are runner-ups in the year 2015, and 2018-19.**
 
 
 
• **Jamshedpur FC** is a football club from Jharkhand that was established in 2017 and is managed by Tata Steel.
 
 
• **​They won the ISL winner's Shield during the season 2021-22.**
